description: This file defines a React functional component named ToolModal, which provides a modal dialog interface for adding or editing a JSON-based tool configuration. It manages JSON input state, validation, and calls external callbacks for saving or closing the modal.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Validates the JSON input; if valid, calls onSave callback with current JSON, otherwise sets an error message.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Clears error state and invokes onClose callback.
